items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: They'd been castigated and Harvey Estern (phonetic spelling) had use of the library for the rehearsal band at the YMHA

ctx.x: Travis playing, "How About You" with the rhythm section.

That's right. We used to do a lot of things like that on the raod, but this sort of kicked it off. They asked us to make a small band record, because critics loved small bands, in those days particularly. I think the critics pushed this way and that's one of the reasons for the rise of rock; that's one reason, there are others. They didn't like the big bands; they still don't. They'd been castigated and Harvey Estern (phonetic spelling) had use of the library for the rehearsal band at the YMHA, and the bigness of…
doing that. Another one I like in there was "Eddie and the Witch Doctor". I don't know where these names came about.
